Final review complete. The only change is in src/dotenv/main.py, set_key's quoting branch (lines 184-187):

    if quote:
        value_out = "'{}'".format(
            value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
        )

Backslashes are escaped before apostrophes, matching the parser's single-quote escape set (`\\`, `\'`). This makes literal backslashes, consecutive backslashes, apostrophes, and trailing backslashes round-trip through dotenv_values(interpolate=False). The always/auto/never quote modes and export behavior are untouched, and no tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were modified. Host acceptance and upstream regression tests passed.

Remaining limitations: none within scope. The fix targets single-quoted output only (the mode set_key uses for always/auto); quote_mode='never' intentionally writes raw values and is unchanged, so values needing escaping there remain the caller's responsibility.
